_comment: Smoke-set fixture used by embedders (e.g. SWCanvas) for Node-side text-rendering tests. Shipped as font-assets-smoke-set.zip on each font-assets release. Three fonts at density-1 size 16: enough to exercise the full drawTextFromAtlas path including the font-invariant character branch. Source of truth — scripts/build-smoke-set.js reads this to know what to include in the zip.
